messages:
oncall-bot: [ALERT] streaming.p99_tail_latency for /v1/stream (eu-west) breaching SLO. p95=0.80s p99=12.3s. Error rate small but tail latency spike and sustained chunking stalls observed. Creating incident. :rotating_light:

maria: ack. I'm on it. Observed customer reports of stalls and some clients disconnecting. Paging devon + li.

devon: looking at proxy metrics — outstanding_write_bytes and socket_buffered_count are high on gateway pool 7. Prom query: `sum(proxy_outstanding_writes{env="prod",region="eu-west"}) by (pool)` -> ~3100. p99 write latency 9s on that pool.

li: quick note — traces show server is producing chunks but client(a) windows aren't advancing, so backpressure doesn't drop. Means slow consumers holding up KV cache flush and chunk pipeline. Suspect client-side flow control regressions or TCP-level stalls.

jamie: mitigation options: 1) evict slow clients (graceful close) 2) bump streaming pool capacity 3) enable proxy aggressive write timeout. Recommend 1 + 2 immediately. I can run the admin commands.

maria: please run now. Post exact commands and results. Also tag impacted customers in support.

jamie: running admin now — will evict based on idle/blocked window > 5s and force-close after 10s. Command: ```
# internal-admin streaming evict --region eu-west --threshold-ms 5000 --force-after-ms 10000
```

jamie: started eviction job -> returned: `eviction_job_id=evict-999770-01`

devon: also rolled a temporary proxy config increase for write workers and reduced keepalive grace to 30s: ```
# config patch
patch: streaming_proxy.workers=64
patch: streaming_proxy.keepalive_grace_ms=30000
```

jamie: eviction progress: `connections_closed=1208, avg_close_latency=120ms`. Observed immediate p99 drop on pool 7 from 12.3s -> 1.1s within 40s.

support-bot:  Impact summary: ~0.8% of streaming requests retried or timed out during the spike window (9997702468-9997702520). Two enterprise customers (CUST-102, CUST-187) reported degraded UX, CS tickets created: #5428, #5429. No data loss reported; most clients retried successfully.

maria: good. I'm documenting the mitigation steps and will hand this to next oncall for full postmortem. Next oncall: @dev-oncall (shift starts 2026-04-12T07:00Z). Please follow up with root-cause investigation: client windowing regression or proxy backpressure change?

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0453. Tags: streaming, p99, eviction, eu-west. Assigning to oncall-delivery. Timeline and links: https://internal.redwood/incident/INC-2026-0453. Please escalate to SRE if recurrence. :white_check_mark:
